title: Dan Campbell: Jets hiring Aaron Glenn was one of the best and worst days of my life

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell: Jets hiring Aaron Glenn was one of the best and worst days of my life
sources.description: Lions head coach Dan Campbell and Jets head coach Aaron Glenn were both born and raised in Texas, both played at Texas A&M, they were teammates on the Cowboys, they were on the Saints' coaching staff together for five years, and when Campbell got the Detroit job, making Glenn his defensive coordinator was his first order of business.
